rows.what_the_ink_shows: The page is headed Algèbres de Hodge d’ordre 2 (crops/16_scan025_L406_heading.jpg). It develops the multiplication of a graded algebra from V, W, phi, psi and Q; its boxed central identity is an associativity condition in x,y,t,z (crops/16_scan025_L406_associativity.jpg), followed by Lefschetz and Poincaré conditions. The polynomial $25c^2-32c+16$ and the quoted complex roots do not occur anywhere on the assigned scan or in its source transcription.
